Fonts used by web/css/style.css (latin subsets, variable .woff2, from Google Fonts, SIL Open Font License 1.1):
- Archivo (archivo-latin-var.woff2), weights 100-900, width 62-125: headings (same font as "re" in the logo)
- Familjen Grotesk (familjen-grotesk-latin-var.woff2), weights 400-700: text
- Fraunces Italic (fraunces-italic-latin-var.woff2), weights 300-700: the italic accent words
The Inter and Instrument Serif files are no longer referenced by style.css and can be removed.
